name: Bag Tag
desc: Type a name, pick a font: get a two-colour bag tag ready to 3D print.
about: Makes the flower-and-name school-bag tag for any name and font: a base and an inlay printed separately in two colours and pressed together, so no multi-material printer is needed. Shows a to-scale preview next to an AAA battery, then gives you the STLs.

intents.phrase: …make a name tag for a school bag
intents.desc: Type the name and pick a font. You get the files for a two-colour tag (yellow base, white letters) to print on the Prusa.
